name: intent-recognition
description: Conversational assistant intent detection — classify user utterances to actionable intents.
use_case: Backend for chatbots, voice assistants, IVR systems.

classes.name: weather
examples: Will it rain tomorrow in Paris
How hot is it outside right now
Tell me the forecast for next week
Do I need an umbrella today
Is it sunny in San Francisco

classes.name: set-reminder
examples: Remind me to call mom at 5 pm
Set a reminder for the meeting tomorrow
Don't forget to take the medicine in 2 hours
Remind me about the dentist appointment Friday
Set an alarm for 8 in the morning
Notify me when the laundry is done
Tell me when it's time to leave for the airport

classes.name: play-music
examples: Put on the latest Taylor Swift album
Resume the song from where I left off
I want to hear pop hits from the 2000s

classes.name: navigation
examples: How do I get to the nearest gas station
Avoid tolls on the way to the airport
Take me to a coffee shop nearby
How long is the drive to Boston
Show me restaurants on my way
